packageRules.description: CLIs that must match a running server: bump only after Omni, Talos or Kubernetes is upgraded.
prBodyNotes: Merge only after the Omni server, Talos and Kubernetes in talos-argocd-proxmox run these versions.

packageRules.description: Review major upgrades separately from routine updates and each other.
Strata is a fast-moving fork: bump the upstream commit only on approval, never automerge.
prBodyNotes: Also bump images/strata/VERSION in this PR to `<upstream CMakeLists version, padded to four numbers (0.1.57 -> 0.1.57.0)>-<first 7 of the new commit>-sm86` (drop any fifth image-revision number); the pin check fails until it matches. After the image publishes, Renovate opens the digest bump in talos-argocd-proxmox.

prBodyNotes: Bump images/vllm-qwen38-dualfast/VERSION and re-check all vendored patch anchors before merging.
